read.thesis: Amex raised FY26 revenue growth guidance to 10% on 9% FX-adjusted billed business growth, the strongest in three years, while holding EPS at $17.30–$17.90; supply-side metrics are not applicable to a card network.

triggers.label: Spend growth 9%, highest in three years
triggers.quote: Card Member spending growth of 9 percent, the highest rate we've seen in three years on an FX-adjusted basis

triggers.label: FY26 revenue growth raised to 10%
triggers.quote: we are raising our full-year revenue growth guidance to 10 percent

triggers.label: Reinvesting outperformance into growth
triggers.quote: plan to reinvest this outperformance in growth initiatives given the significant opportunities we see ahead

guidance.quote: we are raising our full-year revenue growth guidance to 10 percent
We continue to expect full-year EPS of $17.30 to $17.90.

red_flags.label: Provisions reserve release flatters Q2 earnings
red_flags.quote: The decrease reflected a reserve release during the quarter compared to a reserve build in the prior year

red_flags.label: Expense growth outpacing revenue
red_flags.quote: Consolidated expenses were $14.5 billion, up 12 percent year-over-year.
